notes.title: Closed Playtest Sign-Up is Now Open!
notes.content:
[p]Hey adventurers![/p][p]We’re opening the gates for a [b]Closed Beta Playtest[/b] of Shardbreakers, our fast-paced bullet-hell action roguelike where you [b]craft your own magic[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]This is your chance to:
✨ Play before anyone else
✨ Help shape the game with your feedback
✨ Discover powerful magic combos and break reality itself[/p][p][/p][p][b]📅 Beta starts soon - spots are limited![/b]
If you want in, sign up here [b]👉[/b] [url="https://preview.mailerlite.io/forms/1727446/162418707426969436/share"]\[Sign-Up Here][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We’ll send you a Beta Key as soon as we’re ready to launch the test.[/p][p][/p][h1][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3256040/Shardbreakers/"][/dynamiclink][/h1][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Announcing Shardbreakers!
notes.content: [p]We’re thrilled to finally unveil [b]Shardbreakers[/b] - a fast-paced bullet-hell twin-stick action roguelike crafted by [b]Embercore[/b].[/p][p]After more than a year of development, we’re proud to drop our Announcement Trailer. Check it out right here:[/p][previewyoutube="CugNLQx1SKw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Free Demo Coming to Steam![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Shardbreakers[/b] will make its debut on Steam with a free Demo - giving players an early hands-on experience with its fast-paced combat, beautifully hand-crafted world, and magic crafting chaos.[/p][p][b]Wishlist[/b] now and be first in line when the Demo arrives:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3256040/Shardbreakers/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]About the game[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]⚔️ [b]Multiple heroes[/b]: Start with 3 uniquely designed characters (more coming!), each offering distinct combat styles.[/p][p]🌲 [b]Hand-crafted worlds[/b]: Explore 3 stunning hand-drawn Biomes: The Forsaken Encampment, The Twisted Forest, The Crystalvein Cavern and more to come. [/p][p]👹 [b]Epic foes[/b]: Face off uniquely-designed enemies and bosses.[/p][p]✨ [b]Craft your own magic[/b]: Combine Shards to craft custom Magic and rain chaos on your enemies.[/p][p]🌱 [b]Progression that lasts[/b]: Upgrade permanently through a rich progression system that rewards each run, win or lose.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Be Part of the Journey[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re building [i]Shardbreakers[/i] with your feedback in mind — so let us know what you think of the trailer![/p][p]And don’t forget to hit that [b]wishlist [/b]button.[/p][p]Prepare to dash, cast, die, and descend deeper into the darkness… again and again. [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://x.com/EmbercoreGames"]X[/url]  [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@shardbreakers"]Tiktok[/url]  [url="https://www.youtube.com/@EmbercoreGames"]Youtube[/url]  [url="https://www.shardbreakersgame.com/"]Website[/url][/p]
